summary: Frontend-only E2E testing (iteration 2) of the 4 new LandedCost features + regression, on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) using Playwright against the public preview URL. VERIFIED PASSING: (1) Config Export downloads 'landedcost-config-2026-08-24.json' (1681 bytes, valid JSON with categories/weightTiers/shippingRates/costTiers/customRules/exchangeRates) + 'Configuration exported' toast; (2) Config Import via hidden input applies a previously exported file (changed VAT 15->0, import restored 15) with success toast; garbage JSON and valid-but-wrong-shape JSON ({"foo":"bar"}) both show 'Invalid configuration file' error toast and leave config intact; import-config-btn opens the native file chooser; (3) History Search filters live by supplier name ('Shanghai' -> 1 row), category ('lace'), generated supplier code prefix ('TI75'), route ('China' -> 1 row for a china-sa record) and shows history-no-results for non-matching query; search box hidden when history is empty; (4) Reuse: reuse-calc-0 and latest-reuse-btn both navigate to Calculate with the form pre-filled (supplierName/price/meters/weight) and the result panel showing the exact saved supplier code (FI210312 / TI753120); (5) PDF Export: result-export-btn, export-calc-0 and latest-export-btn each open a new window containing the formatted quote HTML (Supplier Code / Cost Breakdown / Total landed cost) with no app crash; (6) Regression: reference case (Lace + India + Ship, 20/9/5) = R 92,05 per meter, R 828,46 total, code LI289209; save/persist across reload, delete row, clear-all, and calculator draft surviving tab switches all pass. Mobile: search/reuse/export controls render and work via mobile-nav-*; config action buttons fit the viewport. ONE REAL DEFECT FOUND: importing a JSON that passes the shallow shape check but lacks other keys (costTiers/customRules/fees) crashes the app in-session with an uncaught TypeError in Configuration ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)') - full white screen; recoverable only by page reload (loadConfig re-merges defaults).

ui_bugs.issue: Import validation only checks categories[]/weightTiers[]/shippingRates and then calls setConfig(data) with the raw object. Importing a JSON missing other keys (e.g. costTiers, customRules, customsDutyRate, taxRate, exchangeRates) is accepted and immediately crashes the whole app with an uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)' at Configuration (config.costTiers.map) - blank/red error screen until the user reloads. Fix: merge the imported object over DEFAULT_CONFIG (reuse storage loadConfig/merge logic) before setConfig, and/or validate all required keys.

When the browser blocks the popup, printQuote returns false but every caller (result-export-btn, export-calc-<i>, latest-export-btn) ignores the return value, so the user gets no feedback and nothing happens. Add toast.error('Allow pop-ups to export the quote') when it returns false.

Dead branch: the invalid-input error toast in handleExport can never fire because result-export-btn is only rendered inside ResultPanel when result.valid is true (invalid state renders result-empty instead). Not a user-facing bug, but the spec item 'invalid inputs shows error toast' is unreachable.

issues: Result cap changes with the query (6 rows unfiltered vs 15 when searching) with no 'showing X of Y' hint, so a matching older calculation beyond the cap silently never appears.

Carried over from iteration 1 and still present: exchange-rate chips in the header/dashboard use toFixed ('R 0,21' via rateFmt vs currency()) - formatting helpers still not unified; toasts still render bottom/top overlapping content area.

action_items: HIGH: merge imported config over DEFAULT_CONFIG (or validate all required keys) in Configuration.importConfig so a partial-but-valid-shape JSON cannot crash the app.
MEDIUM: surface an error toast when printQuote returns false (popup blocked) in all three export call sites.
LOW: remove or make reachable the invalid-input error toast in CalculatorPage.handleExport.
critical_code_review_comments: Configuration.importConfig bypasses the defensive merge that storage.loadConfig performs on boot; any externally-edited/older config file can put the running app into an unrenderable state. Use one shared normaliseConfig(raw) helper for both boot and import.

printQuote's guard `if (!record?.result?.valid && !record?.result?.supplierCode) return;` returns undefined (not false) for that path, so callers cannot distinguish 'invalid record' from 'popup blocked'. Return an explicit status.
Dashboard filter recomputes on every keystroke over full history (max 200) - fine today, but the differing slice(6) / slice(15) limits are a hidden business rule worth surfacing in the UI.

success_rate.frontend: 96% - 24/25 scenarios passed; 1 genuine defect (partial-config import crash)

seed_data_creation: Transient localStorage records created during runs (Mumbai Textiles / Shanghai Silk Co / Delhi Trims Ltd / Guangzhou Habby / Pune Fabrics / Mobile Co); localStorage cleared at the start of each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend app, no backend. New testids verified: export-config-btn, import-config-btn, import-config-input (HIDDEN - use wait_for_selector(state='attached') then set_input_files), history-search, history-no-results, reuse-calc-<i>, export-calc-<i>, delete-calc-<i>, latest-reuse-btn, latest-export-btn, result-export-btn. PDF export opens a real popup: use `async with page.context.expect_page()` and inspect popup.content() (url stays about:blank); the auto window.print() does not block automation. Config export: use page.expect_download(). Desktop nav = nav-dashboard/nav-calculate/nav-config; on 390px width those are hidden - use mobile-nav-*. localStorage keys: ipc.config.v1 / ipc.history.v1 (does NOT persist between separate tool sessions - reseed each run). Reference case Lace+India+Ship 20/9/5 => R 92,05 / R 828,46 / LI289209.
rca_of_the_issue: Repro of the one defect: Configuration tab -> import a JSON containing only {categories, weightTiers, shippingRates} -> import passes the shape check, setConfig replaces the entire config object, Configuration re-renders and config.costTiers is undefined -> config.costTiers.map throws -> React unmounts the tree (uncaught runtime error overlay / blank app). State is written to localStorage, but a page reload recovers because storage.loadConfig shallow-merges over DEFAULT_CONFIG. Root cause: import path does not reuse the boot-time default merge. Mitigation: normalise/merge before setConfig.
